commitments.detail: Obtain opt-in consent from all employees prior to the rollout.
Ensure the vendor deletes voiceprints within 90 days of their last use.
Provide notice of the voice-authentication system and obtain opt-in consent prior to deployment.
Notify union representatives of the system deployment at least 7 days prior to rollout.
Ensure the vendor does not monitor off-hours voice recordings.
Require the vendor to delete voiceprints after 90 days of inactivity.
Prohibit the use of voiceprints for any secondary purposes without additional consent.
